title: FSSAI Perpetual Licences & ₹1.5 Crore Turnover Exemption
summary: **Perpetual Licence Validity:** Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) introduced perpetual validity for food business registrations and licences ...

items: **Perpetual Licence Validity:** Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) introduced perpetual validity for food business registrations and licences effective **1 April 2026**, eliminating annual renewal filings.
**Turnover Threshold Multiplied:** Basic registration exemption threshold raised more than 12-fold from ₹12 Lakh ➔ **₹1.5 Crore annual turnover**.
**Street Vendor Integration:** Street food vendors registered under the Street Vendors Act, 2014 deemed automatically registered with FSSAI, benefiting over 10 Lakh micro-vendors.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → FSSAI basic registration threshold raised from ₹12 Lakh to ₹1.5 Crore; licences granted perpetual validity.
